user.title: Connect IneTrack
user.description:
1. Log in at {url}, open **Settings > Security** and click **Generate new API key**.
2. Open each car in IneTrack and copy the browser address (it contains `trackerId=...`), or just the number after `trackerId=`.

data_description.api_key: The developer API key of your IneTrack account.
data_description.trackers: One tracker ID or IneTrack link per line.

names.title: Name your trackers
names.description: These become the device names in Home Assistant, for example the name used in IneTrack.

reauth_confirm.title: IneTrack API key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The API key no longer works (it may have been regenerated or disabled). Create a new one at {url} under **Settings > Security** and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: IneTrack refused the request. Check that the API key is copied completely and is active, and that the tracker IDs belong to this account.
error.unknown_trackers: These tracker IDs are not visible with this API key: {trackers}
error.trackers_required: Enter at least one tracker ID or IneTrack link.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the IneTrack API. Try again later.
error.api_error: The IneTrack API returned an error. Try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: These trackers are already set up.

data.address_lookup: Look up the address of the position

data_description.trackers: One tracker ID or IneTrack link per line. Removing a tracker removes its device.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask IneTrack for new data. Trackers usually report every 30-120 seconds while driving.
data_description.address_lookup: Adds the street address IneTrack resolves for the last position.
data_description.extended_data: Creates sensors for the values the trackers send besides the position. Turn off if you only need the position.
